cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check both files
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep 'type' /opt/areloria/package.json /opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("Current type field:")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Remove type field with a more specific approach - using python
sftp = client.open_sftp()
# Fix root package.json
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/package.json", "r") as f:
    content = f.read().decode()
import json
data = json.loads(content)
if "type" in data:
    del data["type"]
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/package.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
print("Fixed /opt/areloria/package.json")
# Fix server package.json
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/server/package.json", "r") as f:
    content = f.read().decode()
data = json.loads(content)
if "type" in data:
    del data["type"]
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/server/package.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
print("Fixed /opt/areloria/server/package.json")
sftp.close()
# Restart PM2 fresh
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all && pm2 start /opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 8 && pm2 list")
print("\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
PYEOF
